SECTION 03 30 00 — CAST-IN-PLACE CONCRETE

PART 1 - GENERAL

1.1 SUMMARY
A. Section includes cast-in-place concrete for foundations and slabs.

1.5 SUBMITTALS
A. Product Data: For each type of product.
B. Design Mixtures: For each concrete mixture.
C. Shop Drawings: Reinforcement placement.

1.6 DELIVERY, STORAGE, AND HANDLING
A. Store cementitious materials off the ground, under cover, and protected
   from moisture to prevent set. Reject any material exposed to weather.

PART 2 - PRODUCTS
2.1 CONCRETE MATERIALS
A. Portland cement, aggregates, and reinforcing bars.

SECTION 08 41 13 — ALUMINUM-FRAMED STOREFRONTS

PART 1 - GENERAL

1.5 SUBMITTALS
A. Shop Drawings: Include elevations and anchorage.
B. Samples: For each finish on aluminum framing.

1.6 DELIVERY, STORAGE, AND HANDLING
A. Store materials per manufacturer's written instructions.

PART 2 - PRODUCTS
2.1 MATERIALS
A. Aluminum-framed storefront system with insulating glazing.
